name: FIN_ASST_CASE_PAT_ASSET
description: This table contains information related to assets reported by the patient in a financial assistance case record.

columns.name: FIN_ASST_CASE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the case record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PAT_ASSET_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: Type of asset entered by the patient.

columns.name: PAT_ASSET_VALUE
columns.description: How much an asset is worth, as entered by the patient.

columns.name: PAT_ASSET_COMMENT
columns.description: Comment entered by a patient for the current asset row.
